rationale: The agent verified the user correctly (email lookup failed, then matched full name + ZIP to a single account), used read tools to retrieve the user and order, and answered the user’s branching requests. It identified the most expensive item and then, upon the user’s request, sought explicit confirmation (including reason) before performing an order-changing action. It used the appropriate cancel tool and then confirmed cancellation and refund details. The agent acted only on the authenticated user’s order and did not perform any writes without confirmation. Minor concerns: it stated the total amount and refund timeline without explicit tool evidence and asserted that single-item cancellation isn’t supported. However, these did not contradict tool outputs nor affect the correctness of the final action. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
